adjudication_rationale: The system is deployed on health-and-wellness platforms serving clinical populations and directly evaluates affective-state rollouts and offline policy optimization; retain as a peripheral clinical application.
The registered abstract proposes coupled micro- and macro-health dynamics but reports no implemented model, dataset experiment, or empirical capability evaluation.
The official publication is a commentary on language and surgical world models rather than an empirical study or a structured review of the field.

VCHarness searches architectures for perturbation-response prediction, but the evaluated models are endpoint mappings described as components toward a future virtual-cell world model rather than temporal state dynamics.
Stable metadata exists, but sufficient primary methods and results were not accessible to verify learned dynamics and capability evaluation.
The stable report empirically tests an adaptive world-model agent in antimicrobial-resistance and sepsis treatment environments in addition to a non-medical falsification battery.
The journal abstract establishes a spatiotemporal surgical-dynamics model, sim-to-real adaptation, policy optimization, task evaluation, and expert assessment of temporal and anatomical plausibility.

The Koopman world model supplies state representations and model-based reward computation, but the accessible primary report evaluates policy value and action safety without direct transition, rollout, or simulator-validity evidence.
The study trains a masked-latent world-model policy on real dialysis records and evaluates model-based scheduling and resource-allocation behavior in a calibrated digital-twin environment.
The primary text reports direct horizon-48 future inertial-signal forecasting in addition to representation probes, satisfying the dynamics-capability evaluation requirement.
Susagi learns microbiome community stability and directly evaluates zero-shot community-composition dynamics across three biomedical microbiome datasets.
The journal abstract specifies a variational recurrent state-space world model, Monte Carlo treatment-response rollouts, resistance-trajectory prediction, and adaptive-therapy evaluation.
